title: Antigravity Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for Antigravity plugin manifest files (plugin.json)

$schema.description: URL or relative path to the JSON schema.

name.description: The unique, machine-readable name of the plugin. Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the plugin shown in customizations UI.

description.description: A brief human-readable description of the plugin's purpose and capabilities.

disabled.description: Whether the plugin ships disabled by default upon discovery.

logo.description: Relative path to an image file inside the plugin (e.g., 'assets/logo.svg'). Supported formats: .svg, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp.

author.description: Author or maintainer of the plugin.

repository.description: Source code repository for the plugin.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the plugin (e.g., 'Apache-2.0', 'MIT').

keywords.description: List of keywords or tags describing the plugin capabilities.

homepage.description: URL to the plugin homepage or documentation.
